data.name: Sabbir
data.long_meaning: Sabbir is a Hindi name with the meaning 'Bringer of Prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sabh', which means 'assembly', and the Sanskrit word 'Bir', which means 'hero'. Together, these words suggest a strong and powerful individual who brings prosperity and wealth to those around them.
